_comment: Heavy per-product correction notes. The 1688 supplier reference photos for this watch are top-down flat-lay shots, and Higgsfield was averaging the visual cue from the reference into a flat-lay output even with the tightened HERO_PROMPT_WATCH. These notes get appended with highest priority by buildHeroPrompt() to force reorientation. Authored after the 4 user-flagged flat-lay heroes (#28, #29, #31, #36) regenerated still flat once before, 2026-06-04.
heroPromptExtraNotes: REFERENCE-ORIENTATION OVERRIDE — TOP PRIORITY: The variant reference images for this product are 1688 supplier top-down flat-lay photos showing the watch lying horizontally on its caseback against a plain surface. IGNORE the reference image's CAMERA ANGLE and ORIENTATION. The OUTPUT MUST REORIENT the watch into a STANDING UPRIGHT 3/4 view — the case stands vertically as if propped on its bracelet, the dial faces the camera at a 25-30 degree rotation, the bracelet curves down from the case toward the lower-right of the frame. The watch in the OUTPUT is NEVER lying flat on its caseback, NEVER shown top-down, NEVER lying on its side, NEVER wrapped around a cushion or holder. If the reference is shot from directly above looking down at a watch lying flat, the OUTPUT is instead shot from in front at a low 3/4 angle with the watch standing upright. Preserve the SAME design exactly — case finish, dial colour, bezel insert, bracelet pattern, hands, applied markers, brand text, model text, date numeral, two-tone link distribution — but CHANGE the pose / viewpoint. The watch case stands. The bracelet drops down. The whole shot is the standing-watch catalogue presentation typical of Rolex / Watches of Switzerland editorial.
